title: Secret Redaction Boundary
intent: Remove credentials and session material before analysis or persistence.
problem: Without structured header, query, storage and body redactors run before persistence, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the secret redaction boundary contract.
context: This pattern addresses developer artifacts can contain authentication material; its concrete control is structured header, query, storage and body redactors run before persistence.
forces: Correctness requires that raw credentials never reach the evidence vault
Operational pressure can cause: an uncommon token field escapes matching
solution: Implement structured header, query, storage and body redactors run before persistence. Verify the anchored symbol `MaterialError` with `test_authorized_rights_allow_licensed_reuse` before reuse.
invariants: raw credentials never reach the evidence vault
redaction markers reveal no secret value
failure_modes: an uncommon token field escapes matching
raw capture is logged before sanitization
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `an uncommon token field escapes matching` and fails closed if the secret redaction boundary evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For secret redaction boundary, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to structured header, query, storage and body redactors run before persistence.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: developer artifacts can contain authentication material
Do not apply when: the source format is proven incapable of carrying secrets
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: developer artifacts can contain authentication material
not_when: the source format is proven incapable of carrying secrets
